svg.title: The opponent's recorded run
svg.desc: In each of the three Colosso finals, the opponent racing Isaac replays a run recorded as one point of ground a frame, drawn here from the three tables at one scale, seen from above. Azart's run is 3,918 points, about 65 seconds; Satrage's is 4,380, about 73 seconds, and runs the other way; Navampa's is 5,048, about 84 seconds. The game can also play a run mirrored across the finish line. A dot marks every 300 frames, about five seconds. Each frame the opponent steps to the next point, turning by at most a sixteenth of a turn, and when the points run out it walks to the finish.
svg.text: THE COLOSSO FINALS, SEEN FROM ABOVE
One point a frame. Each frame the opponent
steps to the next, turning at most a sixteenth
of a turn; then it walks to the finish.
